Wordmark

“hoy” wordmark from tenant.brand. Image: blue in light, cream in dark. Vector (0033): the brand manual’s script as SVG, coloured by CSS, as a block (`vector`, site header and footer) or inside a heading in place of the word HOY (`inline`, via `brandHeading(text)`). Rules: clear space = the H height of the lockup (⅓ of the script height); minimum 120 px wide on screen, 30 mm in print; display headings only — never paragraphs, buttons, nav links, eyebrows or the <title>.
